specs.title: Multi-tenancy middleware
specs.why: Tenant isolation must be enforced structurally before tenant data exists, or every later query is a leak risk.
specs.scope: Add request-scoped tenant resolution and a Prisma extension that rejects queries on tenant-scoped models when `tenantId` is absent.
tasks: Add `lib/tenant.ts`: implement `resolveTenant()` reading subdomain and session
acceptance: A cross-tenant query throws, verified by `pnpm test`
A correctly scoped query returns the expected row
No call site uses `prisma.*.findMany()` without a `tenantId` filter

specs.title: Auth with phone and OTP
specs.why: Phone-first login matches how the target market signs in, and every owner surface sits behind it.
specs.scope: Implement phone authentication with OTP through an SMS provider port. Normalize Nigerian numbers to E.164. Use signed HTTP-only session cookies.
specs.non_goals: Use the fake SMS adapter in tests. Live Termii credentials must not be required for CI.
tasks: Add `lib/sms/termii.ts`: add the Termii adapter and a fake in `lib/sms/fake.ts`
Add `lib/otp.ts`: implement OTP issue, 5-minute expiry and rate limiting
Add `tests/auth.test.ts` covering signup, login and logout
acceptance: A user completes signup and login by phone and OTP, verified by `pnpm test`
An expired or reused OTP is rejected with HTTP 401
